scope: Texture gap interpolation and adjacent-plane edge colors; unchanged cuboid geometry and strict projection support

neutral_measurement.definition: Exact RGB (166,166,166) within retained face texel-center masks; excludes hidden faces and clipped-away coplanar patches; borders are the outer four chart pixels
neutral_measurement.limitation: Neutral-gray proxy, not a color-accuracy measurement; actual source colors can also quantize to RGB166

current_geometry.status: Existing partial fit remains partial; texture rebake only

validation.viewer: Chromium: initial zero, every construction prefix, all five modes, front/back/reset; no WebGL or JavaScript errors; reference front/back inspected

illustration.renderer: tools/illustrate.py; actual atlas and unchanged reference cuboids

commands.lint: python -m ruff check src tests tools
commands.strict_corpus: PYTHONPATH=src python tools/benchmark.py --strict --case cube --case rotated_cube --case close_layers --output outputs/texture-edges-quality --resolution 32
commands.current_rebake: PYTHONPATH=src python -m cuboid_approximation --ply examples/ComfyUI_00013/input.ply --rebake outputs/texture-fixed --output outputs/texture-edges-current --atlas-size 2048
commands.reference_comparison: bake_model on archived reference preparation/cuboids with the identical cached load_cloud result; baseline texture.py from commit 85ba593, then corrected texture.py; atlas_size=2048
commands.illustration: PYTHONPATH=src python tools/illustrate.py --run REFERENCE_RUN --texture-dir outputs/texture-edges-after/textured --pipeline-only --output docs/images --caption 'Reference geometry / corrected edge colors'
commands.exports: python tools/validate_exports.py --run outputs/texture-edges-after; python tools/validate_exports.py --run outputs/texture-edges-current
